protocol.order: Each round runs arrays-final, then arrays-final-kept; ways and thread counts run sequentially.

interpretation.arrays: List<Ring>, each with an inline int[32]; head, count and cells are changed directly at the element, without copying a Ring into a local.
interpretation.kept: Every way retains the previous state before a tick and includes it in its final digest; Tide keeps a world snapshot and C copies its arrays.
interpretation.noise: The machine was reasonably idle at the sampled boundaries, and benchmark rounds were serialized. Three repetitions show the remaining noise; twelve-thread C varied more. Timings are medians, not a cross-machine guarantee.
interpretation.historical: The earlier arrays and arrays-in-place records are preserved. arrays-in-place was measured under load and is not the final comparison.
